messages:
isabel-fin: FYI we've got a weird one — customer AeroGrid (acct 7022) received two emails with the same invoice_id INV-2026-12-01-7022. One PDF shows a "tax_offset" line (negative) and total=24,750 cents, the other omits the tax_offset and includes a duplicate 'expedited_shipping' charge making total=26,250 cents. Both were sent.

Tom-billing: pulling logs now. Renderer did two successful commits for the same invoice_id. First commit included tax_offset from tax service; second commit came after an event from shipping service and looks like it re-applied expedited_shipping but didn't reconcile existing lines.

billing-bot: invoice-generator: job=batch-2026-12-01-02-33 status=completed renders=2 warnings=2 (idempotency_miss, partial_subledger_join)

tax-bot: Tax lookup: account=7022 jurisdiction=CA status=200 tax_offset_applied=true at 02:29:11. No errors recorded for tax service.

ops-lena: quick theory: shipping-service webhook replayed an "apply_fee" event right after initial render and our renderer's retry path isn't idempotent for external event-derived lines. The tax_offset is produced by a subledger join; retry path ran before subledger hydrate and defaulted to omitting the negative offset on re-render. So two problems: event-driven duplicate fee and missing subledger on retry.

isabel-fin: Customer already paid the higher amount (payment_id=pay_7d3b processed at 02:40). We need to issue a credit for the duplicate shipping charge and restore the tax offset on the corrected invoice. Finance signoff?

cfo-ryan: Approve credit memo for the duplicate expedited_shipping line + processing fees. Please include ledger notes and CC finance@redwood.

natalie-cs: Customer told CS they were overcharged and expect the credit. I'll hold the refund communication until credit memo number is available and will send apology note including brief technical explanation.

Tom-billing: remediation plan proposed: 1) pause outbound emails for the affected batch to avoid more duplicates, 2) backfill subledger for tax_offset for account 7022 and re-run renderer with `--rehydrate-subledgers --dedupe-external-events`, 3) add a uniqueness constraint on vendor_event.event_id and idempotency key on invoice writes to avoid re-applying the same external fee, 4) create credit memo for pay_7d3b for duplicate fee (1500 cents) + processing fee cover (300 cents).

ops-lena: SQL to inspect event replay and invoice lines (read-only):
```
SELECT il.invoice_id, il.code, il.amount_cents, e.event_id, e.source
FROM invoice_lines il
LEFT JOIN external_events e ON e.account_id = il.account_id AND e.batch_id = il.batch_id
WHERE il.account_id = 7022 AND il.batch_date = '2026-12-01' AND il.invoice_id = 'INV-2026-12-01-7022'
ORDER BY il.created_at;
```

isabel-fin: Thanks. I've approved the manual regen and credit issuance. Please CC finance ledger.

billing-bot: manual-regenerate queued: job=regen-2026-12-01-7022 requested_by=isabel-fin ETA=3m

ops-lena: regen started. Running backfill then render; suppressing outbound email until we confirm PDF.

billing-bot: regen completed: job=regen-2026-12-01-7022 status=completed results: invoice corrected, credit_memo=CM-2026-12-01-7022 amount=1800 cents processed=true pdfs_replaced=true

Tom-billing: Confirmed corrected PDF contains tax_offset (negative line) and single expedited_shipping. Duplicate expedited_shipping removed. Credit memo issued for 1500 + fee cover 300 = 1800 cents.

cfo-ryan: Finance ledger updated and credit memo posted. Please link FIN-INV-461 for postmortem and P&L adjustments.

natalie-cs: Sent customer message with apology and credit confirmation. Customer replied thanking us and asked for the postmortem summary when ready.

ops-lena: Postmortem actions: add external_event.event_id uniqueness index, add preflight check to ensure required subledgers exist before committing invoice write, add smoke test to detect >1 PDF for same invoice_id in batch and alert. Scheduling a hotfix PR.

isabel-fin: Thanks team. Closing loop once hotfix is deployed.
